task: Develop a cascade machine learning forecasting system using three specialized U-Transformer models for 15-day global weather forecasts

method_commitments.input: ERA5 reanalysis at 0.25° resolution, 5 upper-air variables (Z, T, U, V, R) at 13 pressure levels + 5 surface variables (T2M, U10, V10, MSL, TP), 2 consecutive 6-hour timesteps
method_commitments.output: 15-day global weather forecasts at 6-hour temporal resolution
method_commitments.key_innovation: Cascade architecture to mitigate forecast error accumulation

limitations.training: Full U-Transformer training not feasible in this environment (requires weeks of GPU time and large ERA5 dataset)
limitations.forecast_horizon: Only 6h FuXi forecast available, not full 15-day

approach: Theoretical framework + data-driven analysis using available data, modeling cascade error growth dynamics based on NWP error growth theory and published ML weather model benchmarks
